diseases.name: Pepper Bacterial Spot
symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions on leaves
Spots turn brown with yellow halo
Scab-like raised spots on fruits
Premature leaf and fruit drop
diseases.favorable_conditions: Warm (24-30°C), high humidity, rain splash, infected seeds

treatment.immediate: Remove infected plant parts. Avoid working in wet fields to prevent spread.
treatment.chemical: Copper oxychloride 50% WP @ 3g/L or Streptomycin sulphate 90% + Tetracycline 10% @ 0.5g/L, spray every 7 days
treatment.organic: Bordeaux mixture (1%) spray, or neem oil 5ml/L with 2ml liquid soap
treatment.prevention: Use certified disease-free seeds, avoid overhead irrigation, crop rotation (2-3 years), remove crop debris

diseases.hindi_summary: यह मिर्च का जीवाणु धब्बा रोग है। पत्तियों पर पानी जैसे धब्बे बनते हैं जो बाद में भूरे हो जाते हैं। कॉपर ऑक्सीक्लोराइड 3 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी में मिलाकर 7 दिन के अंतर पर छिड़काव करें। प्रभावित पत्तियां तुरंत हटाएं।

diseases.name: Healthy Pepper Plant

treatment.immediate: Your pepper plant looks healthy! Keep up the good work.
treatment.chemical: No treatment needed. Continue preventive sprays if disease pressure is high nearby.
treatment.organic: Regular neem oil spray (5ml/L) as preventive measure every 15 days.
treatment.prevention: Maintain proper spacing, balanced fertilisation (NPK 120:60:60 kg/ha), timely irrigation

diseases.hindi_summary: आपकी मिर्च का पौधा स्वस्थ दिख रहा है! सही देखभाल जारी रखें। हर 15 दिन में नीम तेल का छिड़काव करते रहें ताकि रोग न लगे।

diseases.name: Potato Early Blight
symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric rings (target-board pattern)
Yellow halo surrounds the spots
Lower/older leaves affected first
Premature defoliation in severe cases
diseases.favorable_conditions: Warm (24-29°C), high humidity, alternating wet-dry conditions, nutrient-stressed plants

treatment.immediate: Remove and destroy infected lower leaves immediately. Burn or bury them — do not compost.
treatment.chemical: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2g/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2g/L, spray every 7-10 days. Alternate fungicides to avoid resistance.
treatment.organic: Neem oil 5ml/L + 2ml liquid soap spray. Copper-based fungicide (Bordeaux mixture 1%) also works.
treatment.prevention: Use certified disease-free seed tubers, proper plant spacing (45x20cm), balanced fertilisation, avoid overhead irrigation, 3-year crop rotation

diseases.hindi_summary: यह आलू का अगेती झुलसा रोग है। पत्तियों पर गोल भूरे धब्बे जो बीच से हल्के होते हैं, दिखते हैं। प्रभावित पत्तियां तुरंत हटाएं। मैंकोजेब 2 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी में मिलाकर 7-10 दिन के अंतर पर छिड़काव करें।

diseases.name: Potato Late Blight
symptoms: Water-soaked pale green to dark brown lesions, often at leaf tips/margins
White fuzzy mold on underside of leaves in humid conditions
Dark brown lesions on stems
Tubers show reddish-brown rot extending inward
Foul smell in advanced cases
diseases.favorable_conditions: Cool (10-20°C), high humidity (>90%), foggy conditions, rain. Spreads rapidly.

treatment.immediate: URGENT: Remove all infected plants/parts. Stop overhead irrigation immediately. Ensure good air circulation.
treatment.chemical: Metalaxyl + Mancozeb 72% WP @ 2.5g/L or Cymoxanil + Mancozeb 72% WP @ 3g/L, spray every 5-7 days. Or Dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1g/L.
treatment.organic: Copper oxychloride 3g/L as preventive. Phosphorous acid-based products. Bordeaux mixture 1%. Limited efficacy once disease is established.
treatment.prevention: Use resistant varieties (Kufri Jyoti, Kufri Bahar), plant certified tubers, hilling, avoid wetting foliage, apply fungicide before wet weather forecast

diseases.hindi_summary: यह आलू का पछेती झुलसा रोग है — यह बहुत तेजी से फैलता है! पत्तियों पर पानी जैसे काले-भूरे धब्बे और नीचे सफेद फफूंद दिखती है। तुरंत Metalaxyl + Mancozeb 2.5 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी में मिलाकर छिड़काव करें। ऊपर से पानी देना बंद करें।
diseases.market_impact: Up to 100% crop loss if not controlled within 5-7 days

diseases.name: Healthy Potato Plant

treatment.immediate: Your potato plant looks healthy! Continue regular monitoring.
treatment.chemical: Apply preventive fungicide (Mancozeb 2g/L) before wet season as a precaution.
treatment.organic: Neem oil spray every 15 days as preventive measure.
treatment.prevention: Earthing up at 30 and 60 days, balanced fertilisation (NPK 150:60:100 kg/ha), proper drainage

diseases.hindi_summary: आपका आलू का पौधा स्वस्थ दिख रहा है! बारिश के मौसम में सावधानी रखें और हर 15 दिन में मैंकोजेब का छिड़काव करें।

diseases.name: Tomato Bacterial Spot
symptoms: Small water-soaked spots on leaves, turning dark brown with yellow halo
Spots may have greasy appearance
Raised scab-like lesions on fruits
Defoliation in severe cases
diseases.favorable_conditions: Warm humid weather, rain splash, infected transplants, temperatures 25-30°C

treatment.immediate: Remove severely infected plants/leaves. Avoid working in wet crop.
treatment.chemical: Copper hydroxide 77% WP @ 2g/L or Copper oxychloride 50% WP @ 3g/L. Can combine with Mancozeb. Spray every 7 days.
treatment.organic: Bordeaux mixture (1%) spray. Streptomycin sulphate (200ppm) for early stages.
treatment.prevention: Use disease-free certified seeds/transplants, avoid overhead irrigation, crop rotation, remove crop debris after harvest

diseases.hindi_summary: यह टमाटर का जीवाणु धब्बा रोग है। पत्तियों पर छोटे पानी जैसे धब्बे बनते हैं। कॉपर ऑक्सीक्लोराइड 3 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी में मिलाकर 7 दिन के अंतर पर छिड़काव करें।

diseases.name: Tomato Early Blight
symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric rings on lower leaves
Yellow halo around each spot
Spots enlarge and merge, causing leaf death
Stem lesions possible (collar rot in seedlings)
diseases.favorable_conditions: Warm (24-29°C), high humidity, nutrient-stressed plants, wet leaf surfaces

treatment.immediate: Remove and destroy all lower infected leaves. Do not compost.
treatment.chemical: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2g/L or Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1ml/L, spray every 7-10 days. Rotate fungicide classes.
treatment.organic: Neem oil 5ml/L + 2ml liquid soap. Trichoderma viride 5g/L as soil drench. Copper-based fungicide spray.
treatment.prevention: Avoid wetting leaves, mulch soil, remove crop debris, crop rotation (avoid Solanaceae for 2 years), ensure adequate potassium nutrition

diseases.hindi_summary: यह टमाटर का अगेती झुलसा रोग है। पत्तियों पर गोल भूरे धब्बे जो गोले जैसे दिखते हैं, बनते हैं। मैंकोजेब 2 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी में मिलाकर 7-10 दिन पर छिड़काव करें। प्रभावित पत्तियां तुरंत हटाएं।

diseases.name: Tomato Late Blight
symptoms: Large irregular water-soaked lesions on leaves
White fuzzy growth on underside of leaves
Brown-black lesions on stems
Firm brown rot on fruits
Rapid defoliation
diseases.favorable_conditions: Cool (15-20°C), high humidity, foggy nights, rain. Spreads extremely fast.

treatment.immediate: URGENT: Remove all infected plant parts immediately. Burn them. Stop overhead watering.
treatment.chemical: Cymoxanil + Mancozeb 72% WP @ 3g/L or Metalaxyl 8% + Mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5g/L, spray every 5-7 days.
treatment.organic: Copper oxychloride 3g/L. Potassium bicarbonate spray. Limited efficacy on established disease.
treatment.prevention: Stake plants for air circulation, avoid wetting leaves, use resistant varieties, apply protective fungicide before rainy season

diseases.hindi_summary: यह टमाटर का पछेती झुलसा रोग है — बहुत खतरनाक! पत्तियों पर बड़े काले धब्बे और नीचे सफेद फफूंद दिखती है। तुरंत Cymoxanil + Mancozeb 3 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी में मिलाकर छिड़काव करें। ऊपर से पानी बंद करें।
diseases.market_impact: Up to 80-100% crop loss in 1-2 weeks if untreated

diseases.name: Tomato Leaf Mold
symptoms: Pale green/yellow patches on upper leaf surface
Olive-green to greyish-brown velvety mold on lower leaf surface
Affected leaves curl, wither and fall
Common in greenhouse/protected cultivation
diseases.favorable_conditions: High humidity (>85%), poor air circulation, temperatures 22-24°C. Common in poly-houses.

treatment.immediate: Improve ventilation immediately. Remove heavily infected leaves.
treatment.chemical: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2g/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2g/L or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L, spray every 7 days.
treatment.organic: Improve air circulation, reduce humidity. Neem oil 5ml/L spray on lower leaf surface. Copper-based fungicide.
treatment.prevention: Stake/prune plants for air flow, avoid overhead irrigation, reduce humidity in poly-house, remove old leaves at bottom

diseases.hindi_summary: यह टमाटर का पत्ती फफूंद रोग है। पत्तियों के नीचे जैतून रंग की फफूंद दिखती है। हवा का संचार बढ़ाएं और मैंकोजेब 2 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी का छिड़काव करें। पॉलीहाउस में नमी कम करें।

diseases.name: Tomato Septoria Leaf Spot
symptoms: Numerous small circular spots (3-5mm) with dark brown border and lighter center
Tiny black dots (pycnidia) visible in spot centers
Lower leaves affected first, moves upward
Severe defoliation without fruit rot
diseases.favorable_conditions: Warm (20-25°C), wet weather, heavy dew, splashing rain, poor air circulation

treatment.immediate: Remove and destroy lower infected leaves. Avoid overhead watering.
treatment.chemical: Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2g/L or Chlorothalonil 75% WP @ 2g/L or Copper oxychloride 3g/L, spray every 7 days. Start at first sign of disease.
treatment.organic: Neem oil 5ml/L spray. Copper-based Bordeaux mixture 1%. Remove infected leaves manually.
treatment.prevention: Mulch to prevent soil splash, stake plants, weed control, 3-year crop rotation away from tomato/potato

diseases.hindi_summary: यह टमाटर का सेप्टोरिया पत्ती धब्बा रोग है। पत्तियों पर छोटे-छोटे गोल धब्बे, जिनका बीच हल्का और किनारा गहरा होता है, दिखते हैं। मैंकोजेब 2 ग्राम प्रति लीटर पानी में मिलाकर 7 दिन पर छिड़काव करें।
diseases.market_impact: 25-50% yield loss due to defoliation reducing photosynthesis

diseases.name: Tomato Spider Mites (Two-Spotted)
symptoms: Tiny yellow/white stippling dots on upper leaf surface
Bronze or reddish appearance on leaves
Fine silky webbing on underside of leaves and between plants
Leaves become yellow, dry and fall
Tiny moving dots visible on leaf underside (mites)
diseases.favorable_conditions: Hot dry weather (>30°C), low humidity, drought-stressed plants, dusty conditions. Population explodes in summer.

treatment.immediate: Spray water forcefully on underside of leaves to dislodge mites. Isolate severely infested plants.
treatment.chemical: Abamectin 1.8% EC @ 0.5ml/L or Spiromesifen 22.9% SC @ 1ml/L or Dicofol 18.5% EC @ 2ml/L. Spray underside of leaves. Rotate miticides.
treatment.organic: Neem oil 5ml/L + 2ml liquid soap (target leaf undersides). Soap solution spray (2%). Release predatory mites (Phytoseiulus persimilis) if available.
treatment.prevention: Avoid dusty conditions (wet paths), maintain soil moisture, avoid excessive nitrogen, remove weeds, monitor weekly

diseases.hindi_summary: यह टमाटर में मकड़ी कीट (Spider Mites) का प्रकोप है। पत्तियों के नीचे महीन जाला और पीले-सफेद धब्बे दिखते हैं। Abamectin 0.5 ml प्रति लीटर पानी में मिलाकर पत्तियों के नीचे छिड़काव करें। नीम तेल 5 ml प्रति लीटर पानी भी उपयोगी है।
diseases.market_impact: 20-50% yield loss in hot dry season

diseases.name: Tomato Target Spot
symptoms: Brown circular spots with concentric rings (like a target/bullseye)
Spots have yellow halo
Affects leaves, stems and fruits
Fruit lesions are sunken, dark brown
diseases.favorable_conditions: Warm (24-30°C), high humidity, poor air circulation, periods of wetness

treatment.immediate: Remove infected leaves and fruits. Improve plant spacing for air circulation.
treatment.chemical: Azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1ml/L or Tebuconazole 25.9% EC @ 1ml/L or Mancozeb 75% WP @ 2g/L, spray every 7 days.
treatment.organic: Neem oil 5ml/L + copper oxychloride 3g/L combination spray. Bordeaux mixture 1%.
treatment.prevention: Stake plants, prune lower leaves, avoid overhead irrigation, rotate crops

diseases.hindi_summary: यह टमाटर का लक्ष्य धब्बा रोग है। पत्तियों पर निशाने जैसे गोल धब्बे दिखते हैं। Azoxystrobin 1 ml प्रति लीटर पानी में मिलाकर 7 दिन पर छिड़काव करें। पत्तियों के बीच हवा आने दें।

diseases.name: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus
diseases.hindi_name: टमाटर का पीला पत्ती मोड़ विषाणु रोग
diseases.scientific_name: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus (TYLCV) — transmitted by whitefly
symptoms: Leaves curl upward and become cup-shaped
Leaves turn yellow (chlorotic) with green veins
Stunted plant growth
Flower drop, very little fruit set
Whiteflies (tiny white insects) visible on underside of leaves
diseases.favorable_conditions: Hot dry weather, high whitefly population, susceptible varieties, lack of resistant cultivars

treatment.immediate: There is NO cure for infected plants. Remove severely infected plants to stop virus spread. Control whitefly vector URGENTLY.
treatment.chemical: Control whiteflies: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.5ml/L or Thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.3g/L as soil drench or spray. Use yellow sticky traps.
treatment.organic: Reflective silver mulch to repel whiteflies. Neem oil 5ml/L spray to control whiteflies. Release Encarsia formosa (parasitic wasp) if available.
treatment.prevention: Plant resistant varieties (Arka Rakshak, Arka Samrat, or hybrid varieties marked TYLCV-resistant), use insect-proof net (40-50 mesh) in nursery, apply Imidacloprid to transplants before planting, use reflective mulch

diseases.hindi_summary: यह टमाटर का पीला पत्ती मोड़ वायरस रोग है जो सफेद मक्खी (Whitefly) से फैलता है। इस रोग का कोई इलाज नहीं है। सफेद मक्खी को Imidacloprid 0.5 ml प्रति लीटर पानी से तुरंत नियंत्रित करें। अगली फसल में प्रतिरोधी किस्म लगाएं।
diseases.market_impact: 50-100% yield loss depending on infection stage

diseases.name: Tomato Mosaic Virus
diseases.scientific_name: Tomato mosaic virus (ToMV) / Tobacco mosaic virus (TMV)
symptoms: Mottled light/dark green mosaic pattern on leaves
Leaf distortion, curling and puckering
Leaves may become narrow (fernleaf symptom)
Stunted plant growth
Internal browning of fruits (chocolate fruit)
diseases.favorable_conditions: Spreads through infected hands, tools, sucking insects (aphids), contaminated soil. Very stable virus.

treatment.immediate: No cure available. Remove severely infected plants. Wash hands with soap before handling healthy plants. Disinfect tools with 10% bleach or 70% alcohol.
treatment.chemical: Control aphid vectors: Dimethoate 30% EC @ 2ml/L or Imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.5ml/L.
treatment.organic: Neem oil 5ml/L to control aphids. Mineral oil spray can reduce aphid-transmitted spread. Remove infected plants promptly.
treatment.prevention: Use ToMV-resistant varieties, treat seeds (dry heat 70°C for 2-3 days), avoid tobacco use near plants (TMV persists in cigarettes), disinfect tools, control aphids from seedling stage

diseases.hindi_summary: यह टमाटर का मोजेक वायरस रोग है। पत्तियों पर हल्के-गहरे हरे रंग का मिश्रण दिखता है। इसका कोई इलाज नहीं है। प्रभावित पौधे हटाएं। औजार और हाथ साबुन से धोएं। अगली फसल में प्रतिरोधी किस्म लगाएं।

diseases.name: Healthy Tomato Plant

treatment.immediate: Your tomato plant looks healthy! Keep monitoring weekly.
treatment.chemical: Apply preventive Mancozeb 2g/L spray every 15 days during wet weather as precaution.
treatment.organic: Neem oil 5ml/L spray every 15 days to prevent fungal/pest issues. Trichoderma viride soil application.
treatment.prevention: Stake plants for support, balanced fertilisation (NPK 120:60:80 kg/ha + micronutrients), regular irrigation, weed control

diseases.hindi_summary: आपका टमाटर का पौधा स्वस्थ दिख रहा है! बारिश के समय हर 15 दिन में मैंकोजेब का छिड़काव करते रहें। सफेद मक्खी और मकड़ी कीट की निगरानी करते रहें।

general_advice.hindi: किसी भी रोग के लिए: (1) प्रभावित हिस्से तुरंत हटाएं (2) छिड़काव सुबह या शाम करें (3) सुरक्षा उपकरण पहनें (4) खाली पेट छिड़काव न करें
general_advice.english: General: (1) Remove affected parts immediately (2) Spray early morning or evening (3) Wear protective gear (4) Never spray on an empty stomach
